description: This file defines a culture information object for the 'zu-ZA' (Zulu - South Africa) locale in the DateJS library. It includes locale-specific data such as day and month names, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date object to midnight (00:00:00).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the name of a timezone given its offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset string for a timezone name.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the difference in milliseconds between the date and another date.
